caption: An inflated balloon held shut at the neck is let go without being tied, and it shoots off around the room until it drops limp to the floor.

sa.check: An inflated balloon is held shut at the neck.
It shoots off around the room.
It drops limp to the floor.
The release comes first, then the flight, then the drop.

pc.expect: The balloon flies erratically while air escapes, changing direction as the neck whips.
pc.fail: It flies in a straight steady line like a thrown ball; or it hangs in the air; or it flies while still held shut.

pc.expect: It shrinks as it goes and ends limp, and it does not reinflate.
pc.fail: It stays fully round while flying; or it reinflates on the floor; or it grows.

pc.expect: It falls to the floor once empty and stays there.
pc.fail: It stays aloft after going limp; or rises steadily to the ceiling; or bounces back up on its own.

pc.expect: It moves only while air escapes and nothing else pushes it.
pc.fail: It moves before release; or keeps zipping about after going limp; or is pushed along the floor by nothing.

pc.expect: One balloon keeps its number and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: It duplicates; or passes through a wall; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour; or the room rearranges; or the furniture changes.
